A fighting game like Tekken for the PC.

Meaning a lot of moves and combos per character, and limited/no quarter-circle-forward or half-circle or any of the "joystick" moves.

The fighting games I've seen tend to have a very limited combo system. Mostly 4-10 combos/special moves per character (for example C.Viper's move list from SF4). The rest of the combos seem to be unlisted combinations of pokes and launchers.

What I liked about Tekken was it's fluid feel. Even if I didn't know a character I could pretty quickly figure out some moves just by pressing random buttons. The fights rarely came to a stand still. For example, in Mortal Kombat 9 the fights felt slow and tedious because of the lack of combos. If I didn't know a character I could barely even win a fight against the AI without constantly checking the move list.

So in short: a fighting game for the PC that's relatively easy to get into, has smooth movement and fights, and doesn't require an arcade stick to play properly.
